name: Vision Board Curated Library v1
principle: Goal-first, topic-aware, visually coherent assets for vision boards. Photography is intentionally excluded.
ownership: All 250 assets in this package are original SVG artwork generated for the project and may be modified or shipped with the app.

categories.label: Goal objects
categories.description: Rich objects that represent real aspirations and desired life outcomes

categories.label: Life symbols
categories.description: Simple visual symbols for goals, values, emotions and life areas

categories.label: Decorative graphics
categories.description: Expressive accents that make a board feel designed rather than templated

categories.label: Photo frames
categories.description: Curated shapes and treatments for Pexels, Openverse or user photos

categories.label: Scrapbook pieces
categories.description: Paper, tape, labels and physical-collage details

categories.label: Hand-drawn doodles
categories.description: Loose line-art accents for warmth and personality

categories.label: Collage elements
categories.description: Editorial cards and artifacts that evoke travel, journals and memory

categories.label: Word marks
categories.description: Short editable-feeling phrases for inspiration and emphasis

categories.label: Textures & surfaces
categories.description: Subtle surfaces for layering, atmosphere and material feel

categories.label: Accent elements
categories.description: Arrows, underlines, dividers, labels and composition helpers
